mentions.name: Jonline
mentions.description: Federated social media service whose React frontend is being rewritten in Elm. Recent additions include ffmpeg/imagemagick-based image and video resizing, all servers unified behind a single Traefik ingress, cross-site authentication using public/private key pairs generated in the browser, Homebrew/macOS and Linux tarball distributions for self-hosting, and iCal calendar sync that pulls events from locally-oriented ICS feeds. The service runs instances at jonline.io, bullcity.social, and oakcity.social, and powers the author's band's new website at ato.band.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on an Elm rewrite of the React FE of my federated social media service, Jonline (https://github.com/JonLatane/jonline). It’s up at https://jonline.io (and https://bullcity.social and http://oakcity.social).
mentions.author: pseudocomposer
